headline: Approved FY27 capital improvement bond resolution and recommended Northern Border Regional Commission grant resolution to City Council.
summary: The Board adopted its consent agenda, which included approving minutes from September 28, 2026 and a resolution authorizing Northern Border Regional Commission grant agreements. The Board also approved a resolution for Fiscal Year 2027 capital improvement and public improvement infrastructure bonds, recommending Council waive the reading and approve it.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda, which included a resolution recommending that City Council authorize the Director of Public Works to execute grant agreements with the Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC).
Approved the resolution authorizing Capital Improvement Bonds for Fiscal Year 2027 and Public Improvement Infrastructure Bonds, recommending Council waive the reading and approve it.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Councilor Bergman, seconded by Councilor Carpenter, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Councilor Barlow, seconded by Councilor Bergman, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
